```{r read_cellosaurus}
## read in cellosaurus flat file:
# download https://ftp.expasy.org/databases/cellosaurus/cellosaurus.txt file and remove headers to get cellosaurus.txt
cellosaurus <- read_file("../data/cellosaurus.txt")
entries <- str_split(cellosaurus, "(?m)^//\\s*$")[[1]]
entries <- entries[nzchar(str_trim(entries))]

parse_entry <- function(block) {
  # ID: recommended name (one line)
  id <- str_match(block, "(?m)^ID\\s+(.+)$")[, 2]

  # AC: first accession on the AC line
  ac <- str_match(block, "(?m)^AC\\s+([^;\\s]+)")[, 2]

  # SY: zero or more lines; each may contain many synonyms separated by ';'
  sy_lines <- str_match_all(block, "(?m)^SY\\s+(.+)$")[[1]]
  sy_raw <- if (nrow(sy_lines)) sy_lines[, 2] else character(0)
  sy_vec <- if (length(sy_raw)) unlist(str_split(sy_raw, "\\s*;\\s*")) else character(0)
  sy_vec <- sy_vec[sy_vec != ""]

  # Build rows: one row for ID + one per synonym (if any)
  tibble(
    id = ifelse(length(id), id, NA_character_),
    ac = ifelse(length(ac), ac, NA_character_),
    name_or_synonym = c(ifelse(length(id), id, character(0)), sy_vec)
  )
}

if (!file.exists("../data/cellosaurus_entry_lookup.RData")) {
    entry_lookup <- map_dfr(entries, parse_entry) %>%
        filter(!is.na(ac), !is.na(name_or_synonym)) %>%
        distinct(ac, name_or_synonym, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        mutate(name_or_synonym = toupper(name_or_synonym)) %>%
        mutate(name_or_synonym = sub("^#", "", name_or_synonym)) %>%
        select(ac, id, name_or_synonym)

    save(entry_lookup, file = "../data/cellosaurus_entry_lookup.RData")
} else {
    load("../data/cellosaurus_entry_lookup.RData")
}

head(entry_lookup)
```

```{r}
load("../data/Shorthouse_2022_preprocessed.RData")

# map Cellosaurus accessions to Shorthouse_2022 cell line names by the name or synonym
cell_lines <- 
    data.frame(
        name =Shorthouse_2022_preprocessed$samples$name
    ) %>%

cell_lines[!cell_lines$matched, "name"]
```

```{r}
  "NCIH2444",   "CVCL_1552", "NCI-H2444", TRUE,

  "NCIH460DNP53","CVCL_0459","NCI-H460",  TRUE,

## Remove ONLY the unmatched placeholders for these names
cell_lines_working <- cell_lines %>%
    filter(matched != FALSE)

## Append the manual rows

## drop duplicates and add n_matched column
# n_matched counts how often a cell line name was matched to a cellosaurus accession 
cell_lines_working <- cell_lines_working %>%
  dplyr::distinct(name, ac, id, .keep_all = TRUE)

cell_lines_working <- cell_lines_working %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  mutate(n_matched = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

print(unique(cell_lines_working[cell_lines_working$n_matched > 1, "name"]), n=100)

# multiple-match cell line names:
# COLO205
# EBC1
# HT29
# LK2
# M14
# PC3


preferred_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name,   ~preferred_ac,
  "PC3",   "CVCL_0035",
  "M14",   "CVCL_1395",
  "COLO205","CVCL_0218",

  "HT29",  "CVCL_0320",
  "LK2",   "CVCL_1377"
)

cell_lines_working <- cell_lines_working %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(
    # collapse ac and id side by side in the same order
    ac_list = paste(ac[order(ac)], collapse = "; "),
    id_list = paste(id[order(ac)], collapse = "; "),
    n_matched = dplyr::n_distinct(ac),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cell_lines_working <- cell_lines_working %>%
  # join in preferred mapping
  left_join(preferred_map, by = "name") %>%
  mutate(
    ac_preferred = dplyr::coalesce(
      preferred_ac,                              # use curated choice if exists
      if_else(n_matched == 1, ac_list, NA_character_)  # otherwise, reuse ac_list if only one
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-preferred_ac)


cell_lines_df <- cell_lines_working
```

```{r Cellosaurus_API_call}

query_fields <- "id, sy, ac, acas, sequence-variation, cell-type, derived-from-site, part-of, ca, di"

fetch_cellosaurus_one <- function(ac, fields) {
  if (is.na(ac) || ac == "") {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  message("Fetching accession: ", ac)
  
  resp_txt <- httr::GET(
    url = sprintf("https://api.cellosaurus.org/cell-line/%s", ac),
    query = list(fields = fields, format = "tsv")
  ) %>% httr::content(as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  
  # Force all columns to character to avoid type mismatch
  df <- read_tsv(resp_txt, show_col_types = FALSE,
                 col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c"))
  
  # Quick sanity check
  # print(head(df))
  
  return(df)
}

api_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
    cell_lines_df$ac_preferred,
    ~fetch_cellosaurus_one(.x, query_fields)
)

cell_lines_df_joined <- cell_lines_df %>%
  left_join(unique(api_results), by = c("ac_preferred" = "ac"))

```

```{r extract_mutation_info}

extract_genes <- function(seqvar_col) {
  if (is.na(seqvar_col)) return(NA_character_)
  
  # split multiple mutations separated by |
  muts <- unlist(strsplit(seqvar_col, "\\|"))
  
  # for each mutation, split by ";" and take the 4th part (gene symbol)
  genes <- vapply(muts, function(m) {
    parts <- strsplit(m, ";")[[1]]
    if (length(parts) >= 4) {
      gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$", "", parts[4])  # trim spaces
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  }, character(1))
  
  genes <- unique(na.omit(genes))
  paste(genes, collapse = "; ")
}

cell_lines_df_extracted <- cell_lines_df_joined %>%
  mutate(mutated_genes = vapply(`sequence-variation`, extract_genes, character(1))) %>% unique()

```

```{r join_Cellosaurus_data}

Shorthouse_2022 <- Shorthouse_2022_preprocessed

Shorthouse_2022$samples <- 
    Shorthouse_2022$samples %>%
    rownames_to_column(
        "rowname"
    ) %>%
    merge(
        .,
        cell_lines_df_extracted %>% 
            select(
                name,
                ac_preferred,
                mutated_genes,
                derived_from_site = "derived-from-site",
                cell_type = `cell-type`
            ),
        by.x = "name",
        by.y = "name",
        all.x = TRUE    
    ) %>%
    column_to_rownames(
        "rowname"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        derived_from_site = derived_from_site %>%
            str_extract("(?<=;)[^;]+") %>%
            str_trim() %>%
            str_remove("\\.$")
    )

# since the Shorthouse_2022 data came with the RRID column, which already contains Cellosaurus accessions,
# we may compare those to the newly retrieved ones:

print(
    Shorthouse_2022$samples[which(Shorthouse_2022$samples$RRID != Shorthouse_2022$samples$ac_preferred), c("name", "RRID", "ac_preferred")]
)

# -> the only non-matching RRID to ac_preferred columns are those, where the Shorthouse data
#    did not provide any accession. In these cases, this script fills in those gaps
```

```{r join_chemical_class_info}
# add Classyfire chemicalclass to metabolite feature metadata
library(MetaProViz)
chemicalclass <- MetaProViz::metsigdb_chemicalclass()

features_Shorthouse <- Shorthouse_2022$features

normalize_hmdb_id <- function(x) {
    x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
    has_hmdb <- grepl("^HMDB", x)
    digits <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", x)
    normalized <- ifelse(
        has_hmdb & digits != "",
        paste0("HMDB", stringr::str_pad(digits, width = 7, side = "left", pad = "0")),
        x
    )
    normalized[is.na(x)] <- NA_character_
    normalized
}

chemicalclass_norm <- chemicalclass %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
        class_source_id_norm = normalize_hmdb_id(class_source_id),
        ClassyFire_super_class = as.character(ClassyFire_super_class)
    )

enrich_with_metabolite_class <- function(feature_df, class_map) {
    feature_tmp <- feature_df %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("feature_rowname") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            feature_row_id = dplyr::row_number(),
            hmdb = as.character(hmdb)
        )

    feature_hmdb_long <- feature_tmp %>%
        dplyr::select(feature_row_id, hmdb) %>%
        tidyr::separate_rows(hmdb, sep = ";") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(hmdb = normalize_hmdb_id(hmdb)) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(hmdb), hmdb != "")

    feature_class_map <- feature_hmdb_long %>%
        dplyr::left_join(class_map, by = c("hmdb" = "class_source_id_norm")) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(ClassyFire_super_class), ClassyFire_super_class != "") %>%
        dplyr::group_by(feature_row_id, ClassyFire_super_class) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(class_count = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
        dplyr::arrange(feature_row_id, dplyr::desc(class_count)) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
            metabolite_class = dplyr::first(ClassyFire_super_class),
            .groups = "drop"
        )

    feature_tmp %>%
        dplyr::left_join(feature_class_map, by = "feature_row_id") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(metabolite_class = dplyr::na_if(metabolite_class, "")) %>%
        dplyr::select(-feature_row_id) %>%
        tibble::column_to_rownames("feature_rowname")
}

features_Shorthouse <- enrich_with_metabolite_class(features_Shorthouse, chemicalclass_norm)

Shorthouse_2022$features <- features_Shorthouse
```

```{r}
# harmonise the derived_from_site sample metadata
# this data comes from cellosaurus and is very detailed.
# Build:
# 1) derived_from_site_general (anatomical generalisation)

site_rules <- tibble::tribble(
  ~pattern,                                                     ~general_site,
  "^Not specified$",                                            NA_character_,
  "^Bone marrow$",                                              "Bone marrow",
  "^Peripheral blood$",                                         "Blood",
  "^Cerebrospinal fluid$",                                      "CSF",
  "Ascites|effusion",                                           "Body fluid",
  "lymph node|lymph duct",                                      "Lymphatic",
  "^Brain",                                                     "Brain",
  "^Bone(,|$)|innominate bone|acetabulum|femur|humerus|tibia|vertebra|jaw|maxilla", "Bone",
  "skin|dermis|hypodermis",                                     "Skin",
  "muscle|perineus|brachialis",                                 "Muscle",
  "^Lung|^Lung,",                                               "Lung/Pleura",
  "^Pleura$|pleura",                                            "Lung/Pleura",
  "^Liver$",                                                    "Liver",
  "intrahepatic bile duct|^Bile duct|^Gallbladder",             "Biliary tract",
  "^Kidney|renal pelvis",                                       "Kidney",
  "^Prostate$",                                                 "Prostate",
  "^Stomach$",                                                  "Stomach",
  "^Colon|^Cecum|ileocecal valve",                              "Colon",
  "^Rectum$",                                                   "Rectum",
  "^Pancreas|ampulla of Vater|islets of Langerhans",            "Pancreas",
  "^Breast",                                                    "Breast",
  "^Ovary",                                                     "Ovary",
  "^Uterus|cervix|^Endometrium$",                               "Uterus/Cervix/Endometrium",
  "^Thyroid gland$",                                            "Thyroid",
  "^Adrenal gland$",                                            "Adrenal gland",
  "^Salivary gland",                                            "Salivary gland",
  "^Esophagus$",                                                "Esophagus",
  "^Pharynx",                                                   "Pharynx",
  "^Larynx$",                                                   "Larynx",
  "^Oral cavity",                                               "Oral cavity",
  "^Urinary bladder$",                                          "Urinary bladder",
  "^Ureter$",                                                   "Ureter",
  "^Peritoneum$|^Omentum$|^Abdomen$|abdominal wall|pelvic wall|retroperitoneal", "Abdomen/Peritoneum",
  "^Spleen$",                                                   "Spleen",
  "^Neck$",                                                     "Neck",
  "^Orbital region$",                                           "Orbital region",
  "^Soft tissue$|^Connective tissue$",                          "Soft tissue"
)

map_general_site <- function(x, rules = site_rules) {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rules))) {
    hit <- str_detect(x, regex(rules$pattern[i], ignore_case = TRUE)) & is.na(out)
    out[hit] <- rules$general_site[i]
  }

  out[is.na(x)] <- NA_character_
  out
}

# include new general site mapping to sample metadata

Shorthouse_2022$samples <-
    Shorthouse_2022$samples %>%
    mutate(
        general_site = map_general_site(derived_from_site) 
    )
```
